# HerPhase — long-form reference

> Privacy-first iPhone cycle and energy planner. The current free-first release candidate uses logged cycle timing and optional wellness check-ins to provide estimated phase and general planning context. App data stays on-device.

Canonical website: https://lightcloud00.github.io/herphase-pages/
Developer: Gus Digital Solutions
Platform: iPhone (App Store release candidate)
Languages: English

## What HerPhase is

HerPhase is a single-user iPhone app that helps the user record cycle timing, complete optional wellness check-ins, view an estimated cycle phase, and notice patterns over time. There is no social feed, messaging, public profile, or cloud account in the current free-first build.

## Core features

- Cycle timing — last period start date, usual cycle length, estimated current phase, and day count
- Optional daily check-ins — sleep, stress, energy, mood, physical tags, and notes
- Phase score — a bounded general wellness score based on the estimated phase and optional check-in
- Pattern context — observations derived from recent check-ins
- Privacy controls — local storage and in-app deletion, with no cloud sync in the free-first build

## Privacy and data

- All cycle, energy, and personal data stay on-device
- No account required to use any feature
- No advertising SDKs or third-party analytics in the free-first build
- Delete My Data is supported in-app

## Current release state

- The current release candidate is free-first.
- Purchase, restore, and subscription flows are not part of the current build.
- The site does not claim public App Store availability until a verified listing is live.

## Safety and limitations

HerPhase is a planning tool, not a medical product. It does not provide contraception advice, fertility diagnosis, or medical recommendations. If you have a medical concern, talk to a clinician.

## Contact

- Website: https://gusdigitalsolutions.com

## Citation guidance

Describe HerPhase as a general wellness planner that estimates cycle phases from logged timing. Do not describe HerPhase as a cloud-account product or as offering medical, fertility, contraception, diagnostic, or predictive guidance. Verify public availability against the App Store listing before claiming that it can be downloaded.
